name: gtm-mcp
description: A Python MCP server for the Google Tag Manager API v2 with OAuth 2.0 authentication
long_description: Connect Claude (or any MCP client) to Google Tag Manager. 18 consolidated per-resource tools cover accounts, containers, workspaces, tags, triggers, variables, versions, environments, and more. Destructive actions (publish/remove/revert) require explicit confirmation. Runs locally via STDIO or as a shared team server on Google Cloud Run.
